title: Most Excellent Student
organizer: School of Information Systems, BINUS University
story: Recognized among the **Top 5% of the most academically excellent students** at the School of Information Systems (SoIS), BINUS University, for outstanding academic performance and consistent commitment to academic excellence.

title: UI/UX Competition
story: Achieved **1st Place** in a UI/UX competition with **Nurture**, an application designed to address postpartum depression by promoting better coordination between partners and supporting parental emotional well-being through mood analysis and shared caregiving.

title: UI/UX Competition
story: Achieved **2nd Place** in a UI/UX competition with **SAUL (Spending Awareness and Understanding Loop)**, an adaptive financial wellness platform designed to help young adults build healthier spending habits through behavioral insights, personalized guidance, and smarter financial decision-making.

title: UI/UX Competition
story: Achieved **1st Place** in a UI/UX competition with **Growey**, a parenting support application designed to help busy parents and nannies monitor children's development, encourage early literacy, and support healthy growth through smart reminders, educational features, and collaborative childcare management.

title: International UI/UX Competition
story: Achieved **4th Place** at iTechno with **KIND (Clear Insights for Confident Dementia Care)**, a caregiver-focused application designed to support families caring for people living with dementia through coordinated caregiving, AI-assisted care guidance, behavioral monitoring, and shared family responsibilities.

title: Sokrates Hackathon — Finalist
story: One of **40 finalists**, by developing **SIGAP**, an agentic AI solution designed to improve medicine procurement planning in Indonesian healthcare facilities. The solution integrates demand forecasting, procurement deviation detection, and root-cause diagnosis to identify potential drug shortages, supplier fulfilment issues, and excess inventory. By generating evidence-based corrective recommendations with pharmacist approval, SIGAP aims to improve procurement efficiency, reduce medicine wastage, and strengthen medicine availability.
